summary.text: John Douglas Barr II is an independent candidate for the Rhode Island State Senate, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he owns Bedbug Extermination RI and was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2020.

paragraphs.text: John Douglas Barr II ran for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 46, in 2012 and lost the Democratic primary to incumbent Jeremiah O'Grady.
In 2020 he won the Democratic primary for Rhode Island State Senate District 17 and then lost the general election to incumbent Republican Thomas Paolino, 40.7 percent to 59.1 percent.
According to Ballotpedia, he and his wife Sharon have four children.
